text: The TDA2030  is a monolithic integrated circuit in the  Pentawatt®  package,  intended  for  use as a low frequency  class-AB amplifier.  Typically it provides 14  W output  power  (d = 0.5%) at 14  V/4  Ω.  At ±14 V or 28  V,  the guaranteed output power  is 12  W on  a  4  Ω  load  and 8 W  on  an 8  Ω (DIN45500). The TDA2030  provides  high output  current and has very  low  harmonic and crossover  distortion. Furthermore,  the device  incorporates  an  original (and  patented)  short-circuit  protection  system comprising an  arrangement  for automatically limiting the dissipated  power so  as  to  keep  the operating point  of  the  output  transistors within their safe  operating  range.  A conventional  thermal shutdown  system is  also included.

text:
The TDA2030 is a monolithic integrated circuit in a Pentawatt package, designed to operate as a Class AB audio amplifier. Typically, it can provide 14W of output power (with 0.5% distortion) when using a 14V supply and a 4Ω load impedance. When operating with a symmetrical supply of ±14V (equivalent to 28V), the circuit ensures an output power of 12W into a 4Ω load and 8W into an 8Ω load according to DIN45500.

The TDA2030 is capable of providing high output current while maintaining extremely low harmonic and crossover distortion. In addition, it integrates an advanced, patented short circuit protection system that automatically limits the power dissipation to keep the output transistors operating within the safe range. In addition, the device is also equipped with a standard overheating protection mechanism to ensure durability and stability during use.
